intended_change: Unchanged Dinomaly-B baseline on audited DACL v3 seed-42 splits; new JSON polygon dataset adapter, with 14 damage labels and five object labels excluded. Freeze this and repaired Bridge512 as future paired benchmarks.

training.model_input: full-frame 512 to 392 resize; no spatial crop

validation.checkpoint_selection: maximum image AUROC; tie-break pixel AP

metrics.image_score: mean of top 1% smoothed anomaly map pixels

smoke_gate: Separate three-step GPU train + validation + checkpoint roundtrip must pass before full run; smoke is not a final result.
gpu_policy: Wait for GPU0 free memory >= 12288 MiB; do not interrupt other jobs. Recheck clean published commit before smoke/full launch.
publication_gate: Push plan/code/profile, verify GitHub branch HEAD, sync clean server checkout; runtime config records actual git_commit.
comparison_limit: Compare model improvements within each fixed dataset; class prevalence and normal training size differ substantially between datasets. DACL content grouping does not certify bridge/session independence.
